title: Continuous-time reduced Layer-ROM ladder rebase against the temporally qualified Reference limit
scientific_question: After removing both finite Reference temporal truncation and reduced-candidate Heun integration error, what fixed-head fidelity remains attributable to vertical representation and the unchanged Layer-ROM closure across the six-material transfer panel?

trigger.reason: B1HCL demonstrated that the former equal-grid R16_OP residual was finite Reference temporal truncation. Reduced candidates must now be compared in independently resolved continuous-time form before model-form attribution.

scope.bottom_boundary: zero prescribed pressure head at fixed 160 cm

governing_candidate: DOP853_STRICT after per-representation oracle agreement passes

reference_limit.formula: R_star = 2 * REF_DT_1P25E4 - REF_DT_2P5E4, pointwise at common output coordinates
reference_limit.qualification: B1HCL prospective fourth-level holdout supported first-order limit on all six materials and five observables
reference_limit.source_files: fine Reference from immutable B1HCK material artifact plus ultra Reference from immutable B1HCL material artifact
reference_limit.note: R_star is an observable-space temporal-limit estimate, not a new Richards state trajectory or production route.

oracle_agreement_gate.rule: For each material, representation and component, DOP853-versus-Radau RMS <= max(component floor, 0.01 * DOP853-versus-R_star RMS).
oracle_agreement_gate.role: Numerical-resolution gate only. The 0.01 factor is frozen before reduced continuous-time responses and is not a hydrological tolerance.
oracle_agreement_gate.failure: Any unresolved representation/component is excluded from scientific rebase and causes panel decision B1HCM_NUMERICAL_ORACLE_UNRESOLVED.

response_vector: total-storage RMS and maximum absolute error versus R_star
cumulative-bottom-exchange RMS and maximum absolute error versus R_star
QAVG RMS and maximum absolute error versus R_star
QEND RMS and maximum absolute error versus R_star
mapped 10-cm theta RMS and maximum absolute error versus R_star
maximum absolute final cumulative-bottom-exchange error across histories
DOP853 versus Radau numerical-oracle RMS for every primary component
R16_OP residual versus R_star as temporal-limit closure/operator identity control

placement_test.support_rule: Targeted placement is supported only if no worse than the uniform control in every primary component within exact metric equality tolerance 1e-12 for continuous metrics and integer equality for sign counts, and strictly better in at least one.

dimension_test.rule: Report every componentwise transition. Do not select an application-acceptable minimum without external purpose tolerances.

model_form_interpretation.equal_grid_rule: If R16_OP DOP853-to-R_star is within the inherited numerical floor on all five continuous components and has zero QAVG/QEND sign mismatch, equal-grid Layer-ROM closure/operator is numerically consistent with the temporally extrapolated Reference laboratory.
model_form_interpretation.reduced_residual_rule: Residuals of numerically resolved reduced members relative to R_star then contain representation plus coarse closure/localization effects; they are not candidate time-integration error.
model_form_interpretation.no_coarse_richards_attribution_yet: Do not partition reduced residual into Richards spatial-discretization versus Layer-ROM model-form until same-partition CoRichards is itself rebased to temporally qualified Reference.
